ideas.pitch: A predictive spatial-temporal incident forecasting tool for NC State campus security using historical crime data and Poisson regression to generate risk heatmaps.
ideas.title: PackPulse Campus Safety Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of the AI incident forecasting winner by using rigorous statistical modeling rather than a generic UI, which heavily appeals to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered AML and anomaly detection platform adapted for public transit tracking, combining graph intelligence to flag suspicious delays or route bottlenecks in real-time.
ideas.title: WolfLine Transit Graph Intelligence Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates the winning Bito architecture by leveraging complex graph intelligence and explainable outputs, solving a painful localized problem for NC State students.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-agent student support platform built with LangGraph and RAG specifically tailored to answer sustainability guidelines, grant applications, and facility scheduling for NC State.
ideas.title: Triangle Green-Campus Multi-Agent Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent RAG architecture of the GreenNovation Hackathon winner, making it robust and immediately useful for university administrators.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform that ingests daily menus from NC State dining halls and delivers personalized, budget-friendly meal recommendations for students.
ideas.title: Wolfpack Dining AI Nutrition & Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant winning formula to a hyper-local dataset (campus dining), providing instant practical utility that judges love to see.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool that scans satellite imagery of Wake County industrial zones to automatically detect unauthorized land clearing and environmental compliance violations.
ideas.title: Raleigh Industrial Satellite Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the hard-engineering approach of GeoNex-ATLAS, showcasing geospatial computer vision that stands out among standard web app submissions.
